name: accra
description: The Accra coastline, Ghana, where the Odaw river and Korle lagoon discharge into the Gulf of Guinea. River outfalls into the sea are the main pathway by which land plastic becomes marine plastic, which is why this coast recurs in the Sentinel-2 marine-litter literature.
